purpose: Fresh one-shot post-selection diagnosis of exactly the 17 plies explicitly commented on by the user. It cannot train, select, reject, or promote an actor and changes no locked validation criterion.

recovery.reason: The v2 launch failed closed in preflight because its Git-history unit test ran inside an intentional git archive without repository metadata. No canonical case job ran and no ply evidence was produced, but preflight unit tests performed ephemeral two-world computations with v2 production seeds 202608230113 and 202608230444, so every v2 production seed remains retired.
recovery.semantic_equivalence: The ordered v3 case rows must equal the immutable v2 rows after deleting only audit_seed from each row.

seed_firewall.namespace_rule: Production and smoke namespaces are disjoint. Smoke computations cannot consume a production seed, and no v2 audit seed may be reused.

definition_lock.prepare_command: python3 tools/commented_ply_execution.py prepare-definition-lock --root . --lock data/experiments/locked_commented_ply_audit_definition_lock_v3.json --definition-commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) --definition-tree $(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})
definition_lock.seal: After this v3 definition source is committed, add exactly one direct child commit containing only the no-clobber v3 lock manifest. Every later source parent must retain every pinned byte and descend from that lock on its first-parent lineage.

authoritative_final_actor.selection: Reuse tools/flagged_ply_execution.py only to reopen every authoritative result and mechanically derive the winner; no actor is typed into the execution addendum or workflow.

counterfactual.pairing: Every admitted move uses the same hidden world, future deal, and branch-neutral RNG domain.
counterfactual.candidate_support: Evaluate every frozen nominated action and append the maintained actor's selected semantic action when absent; p13 deterministically adds policy-20 top actions before the same append rule.
counterfactual.required_completion: Every branch completes the full remaining three-round match with zero artificial cap terminations.

continuation.contract: Exact 20-symmetry champion-policy argmax at every continuation node; the audited rollout actor is never recursively allowed to grade itself.

belief.information_rule: Only the acting player's sanitized information view and frozen perspective history may influence the posterior; referee hand/deck truth is diagnostic scoring data only.
belief.marginal_rule: All finite card marginals lie in [0,1] and sum to the exact unknown opponent-hand cardinality.

shards.assignment: One ordered case ID per immutable matrix shard; all 17 must merge exactly once.

build.binding: Compile the evaluator exactly once in preflight, record compiler and runner identity, hash the complete transport, and verify the transport before every case and merge.

execution.prepare_command: python3 tools/commented_ply_execution.py prepare-execution --root . --execution data/experiments/locked_commented_ply_audit_v3_execution.json --source-parent-commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) --source-parent-tree $(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})
execution.launch: Only after the unique v3 definition lock is committed, prepare exactly one no-clobber v3 execution addendum and push one direct-parent commit adding only that file.
execution.forbidden: No workflow_dispatch, retry, force push, merge launch, actor input, world input, case widening, optional stopping, training use, promotion use, or v2 seed reuse.

reporting: Merge the 17 immutable one-case JSON shards losslessly, render canonical per-ply Markdown from that JSON, retain every source shard and authoritative binding, embed the complete evaluator payload plus its persisted manifest SHA-256, and seal the self-contained evidence with SHA-256.
